characterDescription: A quietly authoritative navigation rooted in formal institutional codes — uppercase micro-typography at 0.12em letter spacing (intensified from source), hairline underline animations that wipe in from right-to-left on hover and snap to full width on active state, and a seamless transparency-to-solid transition on scroll. The widened tracking creates a more monumental, lapidary quality. Inherits typography from the assembled type system.
